fieldData.event-description:
Get ready to laugh until it hurts — for a cause that truly matters. The 19th Annual Laugh For Sight brings together some of the funniest comedians in the business for one unforgettable night of stand-up, all in support of the blindness community. This year, every dollar raised goes to two incredible organizations: InTandem, which gets blind and visually impaired New Yorkers out of the house and onto tandem bikes, promoting healthier, more active lifestyles one ride at a time, and The Seeing Eye, the legendary Morristown, NJ guide dog school that's been matching blind people with life-changing canine partners for nearly a century. Nineteen years in, Laugh For Sight remains proof that comedy can do more than make you laugh — it can change lives. Grab your tickets, grab your friends, and come be part of a night where every punchline packs a purpose.

Featuring:
Brian Fischler
Cory Kahaney
Peter Revello
Mike Yard
Mark Normand
Aaron Berg
Hosted by Shaun Eli
 

7:00pm Doors Open (Silent Auction/ Cocktail Hour) 

8:30pm Comedy Show 

10:30pm End of Show 

 

GA: $50.00 + 2-Beverage Minimum

VIP: $150.00- Includes Reserved Seating/ Open Bar

 

www.LaughForsight.com
